staleness_law: This report is stale against any head other than binding.basis_commit. claim_boundary: A current-main, exact-basis release blocker ledger and go/no-go input for the prospective 0.2.0 final release. It classifies evidence and routes work; it does not fix defects, prove unavailable operator settings or live repository settings, authorize a release, or change product behavior, versions, credentials, or publication state. Unavailable source, live settings, unexecuted operator queries, and ambiguous premises stay explicit and never count as NotReproduced. The release gate belongs to the owner under #3760.
